summary: This is a routine SEC disclosure by RYVYL Inc. regarding the memorialization of a previously disclosed settlement with the SEC, involving no monetary penalty and no admission of wrongdoing. The filing confirms SEC approval of the settlement terms and that the complaint contains no new claims, only the formal court endorsement remains pending. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is being announced. The filing contains no deal terms, advisor names, or shareholder action items. It is a standard update on a regulatory matter, not a special situation event.
